***Please note this property has been virtually staged***

34 The Poplars presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a highly desirable two-bedroom semi-detached townhouse, superbly positioned within the sought-after Monkstown Valley development, just a short stroll from the heart of Monkstown Village.

Built circa 1980, Monkstown Valley is a mature and exceptionally well-maintained development situated off the Monkstown Road. Comprising an attractive mix of townhouses and apartments, it enjoys an enviable reputation for its peaceful surroundings, beautifully landscaped communal areas and outstanding convenience, with the vibrant amenities of both Monkstown and Blackrock villages close at hand, together with the many attractions of the nearby coastline.

Occupying an attractive position within a quiet courtyard of just six homes overlooking a central green area, the property offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The ground floor comprises an entrance hall with a walk-in cloakroom cupboard, leading to an open-plan living/dining room featuring a raised brick fireplace and French doors opening onto a private terrace, creating an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining. The separate kitchen has been recently refurbished with contemporary cabinetry and new appliances, and a separate understairs utility area houses the washing machine and drier.

Upstairs, there are two well-appointed bedrooms, including a generous double and a spacious single, both benefiting from built-in wardrobes. A stylishly upgraded shower room completes the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, residents enjoy landscaped communal gardens, generous unrestricted parking throughout the development, and the tranquillity of this well-established residential setting.

The location is second to none. Monkstown Village, with its excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, boutiques and bars, is just a short walk away, while Blackrock Village and Dun Laoghaire offer an even wider array of shopping, dining and leisure facilities. The seafront at Seapoint, together with its popular bathing spot and scenic coastal walks, is also within easy reach. Excellent transport links include numerous Dublin Bus routes, Seapoint DART Station, approximately a 10-minute walk away, and the Aircoach service from Monkstown Village, providing direct access to Dublin Airport.
Combining a superb location, stylish presentation and a peaceful setting, 34 The Poplars is an ideal home for first-time buyers, downsizers and investors alike. 

Viewing is highly recommended.

ENTRANCE PORCH
Porch area with door to walk-in cloakroom cupboard.

LIVING ROOM / DINING ROOM
4.38m x 4.64m
Feature raised brick fireplace with tiled hearth. Quality laminate flooring. Door to understairs utility area with Beko washing machine/drier and storage for vacuum etc. Double French doors overlooking the west facing terrace.

KITCHEN
2.4m x 1.83m
Newly fitted shaker style kitchen incorporating worktop area with tiled splashback and stainless-steel sink and drainer. Undercounter Nordmende over and fridge/freezer and Nordmende 4 ring electric hob with Hoover extractor and laminate flooring.

Stairs to 1st floor
LANDING
1.8m x 1.11m
Laminate flooring. Door to hotpress with insulated cylinder.

BEDROOM 1
3.26m x 2.66m
Laminate flooring and built-in double wardrobe.

BEDROOM 2
3.26m x 1.86m
Laminate flooring and built-in single wardrobe.

BATHROOM
1.84m x 1.64m
White suite incorporating a walk-in shower enclosure with rain head and hand-held fittings, wash hand basin in vanity with drawer, WC and fully tiled walls and floor.

OUTSIDE
The property enjoys a private west-facing terrace, while to the front it overlooks a charming communal green, enhancing the sense of space and tranquillity. The development is further complemented by landscaped communal gardens and an abundance of resident and visitor parking throughout.

•	Recently upgraded two-bed townhouse
•	Light filled interiors extending to approx. 50 sq.m. (538 sq.ft.)
•	West facing private terrace
•	Newly fitted kitchen and appliances
•	Stylish recently upgraded bathroom 
•	Quality laminate floor throughout and new carpet on stairs
•	Ample parking throughout the development
•	Close to an array of shopping and eating options 
•	Highly regarded and well-maintained development
•	Excellent transport links including bus routes and the Dart at Seapoint Station
